description: IELTS Academic Reading: 60 minutes, 40 questions, 3 long passages. Question types covered: identifying information (True/False/Not Given), identifying writer's views (Yes/No/Not Given), matching headings/information/features/sentence endings, multiple choice, sentence/summary completion, short answers, diagram labelling.
source: IELTS Academic Reading test format — ielts.org (British Council / IDP / Cambridge English)
title: Reading
